How do lifters currently distinguish between a true phase plateau that requires changing goals versus temporary fluctuations that require staying the course?
What structural milestones or guardrails in a multi-month roadmap (e.g., maintenance phases, strength targets, cut limits) provide enough conviction to prevent mid-cycle goal switching?
How do lifters with conflicting priorities (e.g., wanting to look lean now vs. wanting to build muscle long-term) decide which goal takes priority when given generic advice?
